posts.title: There is still room in English
posts.description: Playing Wordle has left me with the impression that there are still so many word-like combinations of letters to be had in the English language. posts.title: Forever tryin' to clear the samples for my new EP
posts.description: I think hiphop entered, if briefly, into a "post-sampling era" in the late 80s and 1990s. Anecdotally, in the music i listened to, I noticed an effort to avoid the legally grey area of sampling, but maintain an authentic workflow and sound.
